comment: Phase 1j.A v2 fixtures (11 cases) + 1j-rebench summary-relevant probes (cases 12-15, added 2026-05-13).  v2 designs each case so the right-answer candidate's COMPOSITE score (w_sem*sem + w_rec*rec + w_imp*imp + w_src*source_weight) ranks 5-8 in pool-of-10 (PASS cases) or 9-12 (FAIL cases) under top_k=8.  Default focus_injection weights at design time were src/config/config_defaults.c: w_sem=1.0, w_rec=0.3, w_imp=0.2, w_src=1.0.  Post-Phase-1j-tuning defaults (2026-05-08): w_rec=0.15, w_imp=1.0.  Post-Step-3 defaults (2026-05-11): top_k=12, source_weights.memory_summary=1.0 (was 0.7).  The bench harness intentionally retains top_k=8 as a stress parameter (see bench_focus_fix_rate.py DEFAULT_FOCUS_CONFIG comment) and tracks the memory_summary=1.0 source-weight update.  Cases 12-13 are designed-FAIL under w_rec=0.15 / designed-PASS under w_rec=0.30 to probe the live-observed recency-vs-paraphrase-ladder pathology on summaries.  Case 14 is a regression guard — designed-PASS under both weights so that bumping w_rec doesn't promote stale items above legitimate recent ones.  Case 15 is the Step-3 retroactive validation — designed-PASS under sw=1.0 (current shipped), would have FAILed under sw=0.7 (legacy).  Synthetic content only (per coordinator pin C2) — no name/ticker/project from the developer's actual memory DB.  semantic_override + recency_override pinned on every seed for deterministic rank without depending on FNV cosine or the bench's default `now`.

cases.comment: FAIL @ both w_rec=0.15 AND w_rec=0.30 — severe dominant-token cosine over-inclusion.  Phase A diagnostic for the cross-encoder reranker workstream.  Right answer is a recent memory_summary about a specific restaurant visit by name (Le Coucou + duck confit), phrased without the dominant query tokens 'favorite' or 'restaurant' (sem=0.50).  9 decoys each contain both dominant query tokens generically (sem=0.93-0.95), recency low (0.20-0.30).  Semantic gap (0.93-0.50 = 0.43) exceeds max recency boost from w_rec increase (0.30 * (0.95-0.25) = 0.21), so weight tuning alone cannot rescue.  Only a cross-encoder reading query+candidate together (or a dominant-token-detection heuristic) can lift the summary into top_k=8.  If Phase A's paid run confirms FAIL on this case, the cosine over-inclusion pathology is reachable at a severity weight tuning cannot fix — Phase B triggered.
